can_fail_a.instructions: Can a bug in the behaviour this test names make the test fail?

criteria.true: yes: some bug in that behaviour fails it
criteria.false: no: it passes whatever the code does, as with a tautology, both sides from the code, or an assertion that never runs

can_fail_c.instructions: If the named behaviour regresses, does this test turn red?

criteria.false: no: a regression leaves it passing

asserts_a.instructions: What does the strongest assertion check?

criteria.behaviour: the output, against a value the test fixes or computes without the code
criteria.hardcoded-data: the output, against a value from the code under test itself
criteria.input-only: only the test's own input or setup
criteria.shape-only: only type, length, keys, presence, or that it is truthy or defined
criteria.interaction-only: only that a mock or spy was called
criteria.nothing: nothing, a tautology, or only no throw

asserts_b.instructions: What does the strongest assertion check?

criteria.nothing: nothing, a tautology, or only no throw
criteria.interaction-only: only that a mock or spy was called
criteria.shape-only: only type, length, keys, presence, or that it is truthy or defined
criteria.input-only: only the test's own input or setup
criteria.hardcoded-data: the output, against a value from the code under test itself
criteria.behaviour: the output, against a value the test fixes or computes without the code

positive_a.instructions: Does an assertion expect a non-empty value that the code must produce?

criteria.true: yes: a literal, an object, true or false, or an error message
criteria.false: no: only empty ([], "", {}), null, undefined, or no throw

positive_b.instructions: Does this test check a value the code returns, not only that it is empty or did not throw?

criteria.true: yes: it checks a real value
criteria.false: no: only empty, null, undefined, or no throw

runs_a.instructions: Does this test run, with no marker narrowing the run?

criteria.true: yes: no skip, todo, or x marker on it or its describe, and no focus-in-file flag
criteria.false: no: a skip, todo, skipIf, or x marker stops it, or an only or focus marker narrows the file

runs_b.instructions: Is this test free of skip, todo, only, and focus markers, in its head, its scope, and its flags?

criteria.true: yes: no branch, loop, early return, or catch can skip or swallow one
criteria.false: no: a branch, a loop over a value that may be empty, an early return, or a catch can skip or swallow one

isolated.instructions: Does this test build everything it reads, so it passes alone and in any order?

criteria.true: yes: it, or a before-each hook, builds what it reads
criteria.false: no: it reads a value another test sets, or a shared object no hook resets

deterministic.instructions: Does this test give the same result on every run?

criteria.true: yes: no real clock, randomness, network, sleep, or unguaranteed order, or it is faked or seeded
criteria.false: no: it uses the real clock, randomness, the network, a sleep, or an unguaranteed order

automated.instructions: Does this test pass or fail with no person acting or reading?

criteria.false: no: a person must act or read its output

restores.instructions: Does this test leave every global, environment variable, timer, mock, and shared object as it found them?

criteria.true: yes: it changes none, or restores them
